verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt returns HTTP 200 at checkout.com/llms.txt, and a second docs-scoped llms.txt at /docs/llms.txt describes products and API operations. Separately, the official MCP server gives agents structured access to the latest API reference and integration guides, which supports agent-oriented docs consumption. Missing for 10: markdown doc variants (docs.md returns 404), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, and independent hands-on corroboration of how well agents use the llms.txt.
